title_en: Psychology Made Simple (20/20): Falling Down, Standing Stronger
note_en: 不仅…还… means "not only… but also…": 经历重大挫折的人不仅可能恢复如初，还可能因此获得更深刻的人生意义感 "people who go through a major setback may not only recover fully but may also gain a deeper sense of meaning." Unlike English, where "not only" can go first in the sentence, 不仅 sits after the subject and before the predicate, and the second half is introduced by 还 (or 也, 而且) right before its verb.
